Import AI 412: Small models, big claims <https://importai.substack.com/p/import-ai-412>

Plus: why your benchmark is probably in the training set

Distillation keeps eating the frontier

What happened: Researchers trained a 3B-parameter model on outputs from a much larger “teacher” and matched it on 7 of 9 reasoning benchmarks — at roughly 1/40th the inference cost. Read the paper (arXiv) <https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01234> .

Why this matters: If small students can absorb most of a teacher’s skill, then the cost of deploying capable systems falls fast. That's good for access, and complicated for anyone trying to govern compute.

“We were surprised by how little data the student needed,” the authors write.

Eval contamination, measured

A new study checks 14 popular benchmarks for overlap with public pretraining corpora:
- 9 of 14 had measurable overlap above 5%.
- Two had near-verbatim copies <https://example.org/contam?bench=gsm8k&split=test> of the test split.
- Performance dropped 4–11 points on de-contaminated versions.

Read more: contam-audit on GitHub <https://github.com/example/contam-audit>
Dataset: clean-evals <https://huggingface.co/datasets/example/clean-evals>
